title and abstract.summary: The study measured how multiple immature and adult traits of the polyphagous tephritid fruit fly, Anastrepha ludens, vary in response to changes in the quality of its larval diet and the density of conspecific larvae.

introduction.summary: This paper's own study is not described in the provided text. This study experimentally examined how multiple traits of Anastrepha ludens were expressed across extreme levels of dietary macronutrient content and across extreme levels of conspecific larval densities in the larval feeding substrate.

methods.summary: This study measured the development of the insect pest Anastrepha ludens under ten different experimental diets varying in protein and carbohydrate concentrations. The study measured several traits of A. ludens, including the number of pupating individuals, proportion of survival from larva to pupa, duration of the larval stage, pupal weight, proportion of adult emergence, and proportion of survival from larva to adult, under varying larval densities and macronutrient content of diets.
